note: Rules that belong to somebody else. Everything in here is a condition another company sets for paying us, which means it can change without warning and has: Creator Revenue Sharing ran for years and was retired on 2026-08-08 with a one-month tail. Nothing in this file is a fact about the world. It is a fact about what X's help pages said on a particular date, and it is recorded that way on purpose.
law: A compliance rule with no retrieval date is a rumour. Cite the date, name who read it, and re-check before acting on money.

programs.verificationNote: CC did not independently read X's help pages in this session and has no standing access to them. Every clause below is Tyler's reading, recorded verbatim as supplied. Treat CC's downstream guards as enforcing THIS TEXT, not as enforcing X's actual policy — if the text is stale, the guards are confidently wrong.
programs.recheckReason: Existing Revenue Sharing members earn through 2026-09-07 and can apply to the new program from 2026-09-08. Eligibility text is likely to be revised at that boundary.

timeline.newApplicants: may be able to apply now

qualifiedImpression.definition: A unique impression from an X Premium subscriber (Basic, Premium, Premium+ or Business), on the HOME TIMELINE, with at least 50% of the post visible.
excluded: the same account counted twice on one post
qualifiedImpression.apiVisibility: NONE. public_metrics.impression_count is a strict superset of this and is not the qualifying number. Only X's Creator Studio analytics reports qualified impressions.
qualifiedImpression.consequence: Any code path that treats raw views as progress toward the 500,000 threshold is a defect. Enforced by verify-work.mjs.

originalityStandard.requirement: Posts must showcase PRIMARY WORK: original articles or reporting, self-shot photos and video, custom illustrations, or genuine analytical commentary.
originalityStandard.thirdPartyWork: Using someone else's work requires adding real value through substantive analysis or creative editing.
explicitlyInsufficient: basic text overlays that merely describe what is happening
originalityStandard.ourExposure: Our highest-performing post is Pokemon's copyrighted card art in a composite, with a text overlay and a Catch'em watermark. Read uncharitably that is the excluded pattern exactly. Read charitably the PAIRING is the original analytical work — a 24-year illustrator continuity surfaced from our own catalogue. We do not get to decide which reading applies.

automation.rule: Content created or posted by AUTOMATED MEANS is ineligible for the program.
automation.consequence: The confirm gate on post-queue.mjs --send is a COMPLIANCE CONTROL, not a convenience. A bypass is not a feature request; it is a path to ineligibility.
